summary: Local::from_utc_datetime interpreted UTC input as local time through mktime, then returned a zero-offset datetime through at_utc. In a nonzero-offset timezone, this changes the represented instant and breaks the Local-to-UTC-to-Local round trip. The fix distinguishes UTC from local input when constructing the timestamp and uses at to obtain the correct local offset. The selected test was added by this fix. Detection requires a nonzero local timezone, such as TZ=Etc/GMT-1, held identical across all runs; UTC can mask the bug. The reversal restores all implementation changes in src/offset/local.rs exactly to the parent. No builds or tests were run.
